Measurements (${scenario:text})
The Scenario Overview provides totals on the selected SubScenarios.
  • Indoor Pollutants:: Temperature, Humidity, PM1, PM2.5, PM10, CO2, Total VOCs.
  • Outdoor Pollutants:: Temperature, Humidity, PM2.5, PM10, CO2, SO2, NO2, O3.
For proper interpretation of last and average measurements, the recommendation is to adjust the time range to 24-hour based for PM, and at least hourly concentration for other pollutants. Use the icon to get more info about the value and colors displayed.
Reference thresholds Good Fair Moderate Poor Very Poor Extremely poor
PM25 (µg/m³) 0 10 20 25 50 75
PM10 (µg/m³) 20 40 500 100 150
CO2 (ppm) 400 1000 2000 5000 40000
TVOCS (ppb) 70 200 1000 2000 5000
Formaldehyde (µg/m³) 15 20 25 30 35
More info about manipulating pannels in the Home screen

panels.description:
(Based on PM10, PM2.5, CO2, TVOCS and Formaldehyde) Latest Index based on scale (Good, Fair, Moderate, Poor, Very poor, Extremely poor), with following thresholds:
PM25: 0-10-20-25-50-75 µg/m³, 
PM10: 0-20-40-50-100-150 µg/m³, 
CO2: 400-1000-2000-5000-40000 ppm,
TVOCS: 70-200-1000-3000-5000 ppb,
Formaldehyde: 15-20-25-30-35 µg/m³.
[Proposal, pending of review]

targets.query:
pm25= from(bucket: "AIR_QUALITY")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "CONTINUOUS_MONITORING_")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.AQ == "IAQ")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id_pilot == "AT")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sub_scenario =~ /^${sub_scenario:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.area =~ /^${area:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pm25")
  |> group(columns: ["area", "sub_scenario"], mode: "by")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({sub_scenario:r.sub_scenario,pollutant: "pm25", mean_value: r._value,
  severity_level : if r._value < 10 then 0
                  else if r._value >=10 and r._value <20 then 1
                  else if r._value >=20 and r._value <25 then 2
                  else if r._value >=25 and r._value <50 then 3
                  else if r._value >=50 and r._value <75 then 4
                  else 5}))
  |> drop(columns:["_value"])
  
pm10= from(bucket: "AIR_QUALITY")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "CONTINUOUS_MONITORING_")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.AQ == "IAQ")

  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({sub_scenario:r.sub_scenario, pollutant: "pm10", mean_value: r._value,
  severity_level : if r._value < 20 then 0
                  else if r._value >=20 and r._value <40 then 1

                  else if r._value >=50 and r._value <100 then 3
                  else if r._value >=100 and r._value <150 then 4
                  else 5}))
  |> drop(columns:["_value"])
  
co2= from(bucket: "AIR_QUALITY")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "CONTINUOUS_MONITORING_")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id_pilot == "AT")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sub_scenario =~ /^${sub_scenario:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.area =~ /^${area:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "co2")
  |> group(columns: ["area", "sub_scenario"], mode: "by")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({sub_scenario:r.sub_scenario, pollutant: "co2", mean_value: r._value,
  severity_level : if r._value < 400 then 0
                  else if r._value >=400 and r._value <10000 then 1
                  else if r._value >=10000 and r._value <2000 then 2
                  else if r._value >=2000 and r._value <5000 then 3
                  else if r._value >=5000 and r._value <40000 then 4
                  else 5}))
  |> drop(columns:["_value"])
  
tvocs= from(bucket: "AIR_QUALITY")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "CONTINUOUS_MONITORING_")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.AQ == "IAQ")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id_pilot == "AT")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.area =~ /^${area:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sub_scenario =~ /^${sub_scenario:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "tvocs")
  |> group(columns: ["area", "sub_scenario"], mode: "by")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({sub_scenario:r.sub_scenario, pollutant: "tvocs", mean_value: r._value,
  severity_level : if r._value < 70 then 0
                  else if r._value >=70 and r._value <200 then 1
                  else if r._value >=200 and r._value <1000 then 2
                  else if r._value >=1000 and r._value <3000 then 3
                  else if r._value >=3000 and r._value <5000 then 4
                  else 5}))
  |> drop(columns:["_value"])
  
formaldehyde= from(bucket: "AIR_QUALITY")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "CONTINUOUS_MONITORING_")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.AQ == "IAQ")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id_pilot == "AT")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sub_scenario == "${sub_scenario}")  
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.area =~ /^${area:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "formaldehyde")
  |> group(columns: ["area", "sub_scenario"], mode: "by")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({sub_scenario:r.sub_scenario, pollutant: "formaldehyde", mean_value: r._value,
  severity_level : if r._value < 15 then 0
                  else if r._value >=15 and r._value <20 then 1
                  else if r._value >=20 and r._value <25 then 2
                  else if r._value >=25 and r._value <30 then 3
                  else if r._value >=30 and r._value <35 then 4
                  else 5}))
  |> drop(columns:["_value"])

    
union(tables: [pm25, pm10, co2, tvocs, formaldehyde])
  |> reduce(
    identity: { max_level: 0, sub_scenario:""},
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      sub_scenario: r.sub_scenario,
      max_level: if r.severity_level > accumulator.max_level then r.severity_level else accumulator.max_level
      })
  )
  |> rename(columns: {max_level: ""})

list.definition:
from(bucket: "AIR_QUALITY")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "CONTINUOUS_MONITORING_")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id_pilot == "AT")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["sub_scenario"])
  |> distinct(column: "sub_scenario")
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
